plugins.name: user-hd
plugins.description: A control panel tucked into the corner above the Claude Code prompt: prompt-cache countdown with a 2-minute keep-warm alert, model and effort pickers, quick settings, and handoff buttons (write one, read the newest).

plugins.name: pr-review-ui
plugins.description: PR reviews as numbered points in the conversation; picking a point opens its code beside it in terminal-browser (the GitHub page, lines highlighted), or in a code pane.
